description:
Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base; 10 signed-wallet free calls shared over rolling 30 days. Read the backend 402 body for x402 terms. Send a bounded HTTPS callback probe and persist the actual response, timing and exact acknowledgment check. Retrieve prior observations without resending.
Operating boundary: One point-in-time HTTPS observation with public-address validation, no redirects and no credentials. Acknowledgment is not proof of downstream work. Continuous monitoring and automatic retries are unavailable.
POST /api/callback-health-monitor. Existing product credentials, signed mandates, and single-use action grants remain required where applicable. This adapter grants no authority and never supplies server credentials. Wallet-authenticated bounded operations service with durable records. See /api/operations-contract for exact schemas, verified scope and unavailable capabilities.
name: wever_callback-health-monitor
title: Callback Health Monitor
